results.name: read-only-explain
replies: The `dispatch` function uses a two-level lookup: it first tries an exact path match with `routes.get(path)`, then falls back to a wildcard handler at `"*"` if no exact match exists (via the nullish coalescing operator `??`). If a handler is found, it calls it with the path; otherwise it returns 404. So routes are matched in order of specificity — exact paths take precedence over the catch-all wildcard.
